description: Early concept screening — market rationale, technical feasibility and business case are established before a program is formally chartered.
The concept, styling theme, and program-level cost/technical viability are reviewed and formally approved to proceed.
Design is validated digitally — CAE, simulation and DFMEA/PFMEA analysis — before any physical build is committed.
Physical prototypes are built and tested; tooling, vendors and manufacturing feasibility are confirmed.
Field trials, homologation and PPAP confirm the design and process are ready for volume production.
Launch readiness, initial production ramp-up and early-field feedback are reviewed to close out the program.
